text:
Marina: Quick sync — Nimbus integration + marketplace co-launch. We need a tight ops plan: marketplace listing, joint webinar, and a short technical blog. Who can own each deliverable?

AJ: I can take marketplace listing + partner comms. will need final assets from product and integrations team by next Tues.

Suresh: I'll own the demo and the integration deep-dive content. Need a sandbox Nimbus account and sample dataset. @devrel-bot can you provision a dev sandbox?

devrel-bot: Sandbox request noted. ETA 48h. Credentials will be posted to #help when ready.

Priya: I'll lead the webinar ops (date, registration, funnel), and draft the landing copy. Thinking Wed 2pm PT for the webinar, 45m + 15m QA.

Leo: For the blog, I can draft the technical narrative + benchmark section (latency/cost comparisons). Need access to perf runs and the quantization/throughput notes from runtime team.

Hannah: I'll coordinate the demand routing and lead flow. Important: marketplace leads -> Salesforce queue should include partner source and product interest tag. Also set up UTM tracking.

Marina: Nice. Two asks: 1) webinar title options, short list by EOD tomorrow; 2) a one‑pager for AE handoff with common objection rebuttals.

Tom (Nimbus): From Nimbus side, we'll provide a co-branded hero image and 1 pager. Also can push the listing to our marketplace week of May 18th.

AJ: timelines: assets from Nimbus + Redwood brand kit by Mon 1945679600, draft blog by Fri 1945679800, webinar Wed 2pm PT (tentative). Does that work?

Suresh: Works for demo team. Need the sample dataset by Thu at latest.

Hannah: For lead routing, here's a quick mapping we should use — share with ops: 

```
source=partner_marketplace
partner=nimbus
campaign=nimbus_co_launch_2026
sfdc_owner=Partner_Ops_Nimbus
lead_queue=partners_nimbus
utm_source=marketplace&utm_medium=partner&utm_campaign=nimbus_co_launch_2026
```

Marina: Perfect. Also recommend a short benchmark callout: "2–4x cost per token reduction for typical prefix-heavy chat workloads with caching + batching" — Leo, can you validate numbers before we publish?

Leo: Will run perf sweep today and post results. If numbers change, we'll flag.

Priya: Webinar promo cadence: announcement (2 wks before), reminder 3 days, reminder 1 day, final hour. Can we commit to email copy + 3 social posts?

AJ: Yes. I'll own partner-facing social + syndication. Marina — review and approve copy.

Marina: I'll review copy. Two more items: (a) tracking pixel + webinar UTM must be standard across partner materials, (b) AE one‑pager should include troubleshooting checklist for model fallbacks.

Hannah: Noted. I'll create the routing sheet and include required fields: email, company, role, interest_level, product_area, utm_campaign. Will post CSV template here when ready.

Suresh: Small gotcha — the marketplace listing requires a 60‑second demo video. Can design/SEs record a short walkthrough?

Tom (Nimbus): Nimbus can shoot a 60s co-branded clip if you supply script/shot list.

Marina: OK. Action log: 
- AJ: marketplace listing + partner comms (owner)
- Suresh: demo + integration deep-dive (owner)
- Leo: blog + benchmark numbers (owner)
- Priya: webinar ops + landing copy (owner)
- Hannah: lead routing + AE one-pager fields (owner)
- Marina: final approvals + AE one-pager content (owner)
- Tom (Nimbus): partner assets + 60s video (partner)

Marina: Please update thread with blockers. If no blockers, we'll move to formal timeline doc and send to Nimbus legal for marketplace listing by end of week. :rocket:
